description: arXiv-to-Production Code & Hyperparameter Compiler — Fetches an arXiv paper's full text (ar5iv), selects method, pseudocode, hyperparameter tables and ablations, and returns a core-algorithm summary, hyperparameters each with a source pointer and a verbatim quote verified against the text, ablation warnings with evidence sentences, and one self-contained TypeScript or Python file that is compile/syntax-checked and literal-checked against the extract

arxivId.description: arXiv id or URL, e.g. 1706.03762 or https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762.

searchQuery.description: Title or keywords; the top arXiv hit is used. Provide exactly one of arxivId or searchQuery.

name: arxiv-to-code
